GRAMMAR_ARTICLE.label: Articles (a / an / the)
GRAMMAR_ARTICLE.action: Practise one article exercise set, then re-read your last essay looking only for articles.

GRAMMAR_SVA.label: Subject–verb agreement
GRAMMAR_SVA.action: Check every sentence where the verb comes right after a long subject.

GRAMMAR_TENSE.label: Verb tense and form
GRAMMAR_TENSE.action: Do a tense exercise set, then rewrite one paragraph of your last draft in the past tense.

GRAMMAR_PREPOSITION.label: Preposition patterns
GRAMMAR_PREPOSITION.action: Learn the pattern, not the word: depend ON, interested IN, discuss (no preposition).

GRAMMAR_FRAGMENT.label: Sentence fragments
GRAMMAR_FRAGMENT.action: Read your draft backwards, sentence by sentence, and check each one has a finite verb.

GRAMMAR_PUNCTUATION.label: Punctuation
GRAMMAR_PUNCTUATION.action: Do a punctuation pass before submitting: every sentence ends with one terminal mark.

WRITING_TASK_RESPONSE.label: Task response
WRITING_TASK_RESPONSE.action: Answer the task fully: state a position and support it with reasons and examples.

WRITING_COHESION.label: Coherence and cohesion
WRITING_COHESION.action: Plan four paragraphs and make each paragraph's first sentence carry its main point.

WRITING_LEXICAL_REPETITION.label: Repeated vocabulary
WRITING_LEXICAL_REPETITION.action: Save the repeated word and two alternatives to your vocabulary list, then use them next time.

WRITING_LENGTH.label: Word-count target
WRITING_LENGTH.action: Plan the answer before writing: an under-length answer is capped regardless of quality.

SPEAKING_FILLERS.label: Filler sounds
SPEAKING_FILLERS.action: Record the same prompt twice, replacing every filler with a one-second pause.

SPEAKING_FLUENCY.label: Fluency and delivery
SPEAKING_FLUENCY.action: Practise timed answers until you speak steadily for the full part length.

SPEAKING_SHORT_RESPONSE.label: Short answers
SPEAKING_SHORT_RESPONSE.action: Use point → reason → example before you stop speaking.

SPEAKING_REPETITION.label: Repeated words when speaking
SPEAKING_REPETITION.action: Prepare two synonyms for the word you keep repeating and use them in the next take.

VOCAB_COLLOCATION.label: Collocation
VOCAB_COLLOCATION.action: Learn words in phrases: note the preposition or the verb that goes with them.

VOCAB_WRONG_FORM.label: Word form
VOCAB_WRONG_FORM.action: Practise the family of the word: noun, verb, adjective, adverb.

VOCAB_NOT_USED.label: Words not yet in active use
VOCAB_NOT_USED.action: Review the due words, then write one original sentence for each.
